values.title: “We deleted about 6,000 lines of glue code the week we moved to Tessera.”
values.metadata: Priya Raman · CTO at Northwind Labs
values.body:
## The challenge

Northwind Labs builds a fintech dashboard for finance teams. Every new feature meant another week of setup: tables, endpoints, permissions, and the types to hold them together.

## Why Tessera

The team moved its schema into Tessera and let it generate the database, the API, and the clients. Row-level rules replaced a hand-written permissions layer, and preview branches made every backend change reviewable.

## Results

Backend setup dropped from three weeks to two days. About 6,000 lines of glue code were deleted, and the team now ships features three times faster.
